  Council Chambers, City Hall – 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor

Welcome to the meeting of the Civil Service Commission. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout the
week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs and Videotapes of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by
  calling (818) 548-2090. Please turn off cellular phones and pagers while inside the Council Chambers.

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are
available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required
  for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services.

All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will

minutes_text:
CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  February 13, 2019
  City Council Chambers

1.  ROLL CALL
  Chair MacCarley called the meeting to order at 5:03 pm.

  Present: Ghazarian 1 Abkarian 1 Devine, Chair MacCarley.
  Absent: Manoukian.

2.  MINUTES
  Action: Consideration of the Minutes for the meeting of January 9, 2019.

  Motion: Abkarian  Second: Devine
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Manoukian

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOT a part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes. Commission
  may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.
  Walter Alvarez, Ignacio Saavedra, and James Griggs addressed the Commission.

4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Recruitment and Examination Report.

5.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Eligible Lists Established.

6.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL- VERDUGO FIRE MANAGER (MARTIN)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Verdugo Fire Manager as submitted.

  This item was removed from the agenda.

7.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL-FINANCIAL APPLICATIONS SERIES (MARTIN)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Financial Applications Series as submitted.

  The class specification for Financial Applications Series was approved as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Abkarian  Second: Devine
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Manoukian

8.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL-COMMUNITY SERVICES SPECIALIST (NAVARRO)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Community Services Specialist as submitted.

  The job bulletin for Community Services Specialist was approved as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Abkarian  Second: Devine
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Manoukian

9.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL- FIRE CAPTAIN (CHAVEZ)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Fire Captain as submitted.

  The job bulletin for Fire Captain was approved as submitted by the following vote:
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of February 13, 2019
  Page 2 of 2

  Motion: Abkarian  Second: Devine
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Manoukian

10.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION - REPORT ON UNCLASSIFIED STATUS PROPOSAL FOR HOMELESS PROGRAMS
  COORDINATOR POSITION (DOYLE)
  Action: Adoption of Resolution
  The Resolution for unclassified status proposal for the Homeless Programs Coordinator position was adopted
  as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Abkarian  Second: Devine
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Manoukian

11.  EMPLOYEE CONCERN REGARDING INTERPRETATION OF MINIMUM QUALIFICATION AND RULE
  INTERPRETATION (DOYLE)
  Action: For discussion and appropriate action.

  After much discussion, the Commission took no further action on this item.

12.  REPORTS-INFORMATION
  a)  Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations.

  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations Report.

13.  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  The members of the Civil Service Commission congratulated the newly appointed Chair MacCarley for
  leading his first Commission meeting as Chair. Mr. Doyle provided an update on the status of the
  Amendments to the Civil Service Rules and Regulations and stated that the next step would be to present a
  report to the City Council. Commissioner Abkarian requested to utilize the title of Chief Examiner for Mr.
  Doyle to avoid confusion.

14.  ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.

  There being no further business to come before the Commission, the meeting was adjourned at 6:53 pm.

  We, the members of the Civil Service Commission of the City of Glendale, certify that the foregoing Minutes
  are a true and correct record of our proceedi  f February 13, 2019.
